title: What's Actually Inside the Earth? 🌍 #shorts
description: We cut the Earth open like an apple: the thin crust, the slowly flowing mantle, a liquid metal outer core and a solid inner core about as hot as the surface of the Sun.

scenes.text: What if you could cut the Earth in half, like an apple?
On the outside is the crust, the thin shell we live on. It's only five to seventy kilometers thick.
scenes.label: CRUST · 5–70 km

scenes.text: Below it is the mantle. Almost three thousand kilometers of hot rock that slowly flows.
scenes.label: MANTLE · ~2,900 km

scenes.text: Then the outer core, an ocean of liquid iron and nickel. Its motion creates the magnetic field that protects us.
scenes.label: OUTER CORE · liquid metal

scenes.text: And at the very center, a solid ball of iron, about as hot as the surface of the Sun.
scenes.label: INNER CORE · ~5,200 °C

scenes.text: The deepest hole humans have ever dug? Just twelve kilometers. We've barely scratched the surface.
scenes.label: DEEPEST HOLE · 12 km

scenes.text: Follow for more of the world, cut open.
